Message.Name: Securities Etn Profit Structure Message
Message.Description: ETN Profit Structure (IFMSBTD0008) — Securities C. Contains 2000-byte details of ETN profit structure.

Field.Name: Message sequence number
Field.Description: A message sequence number given by Market data team - Market data: seq number is given by instruments and boards (※ only for high-bandwidth service) - Batch Data: seq number is given by Information

Field.Description: An explanation of profit structure of ETN(for loss protection ETN)

Field.Name: End Keyword
Field.Description: A keyword indicating the end of a message. (%HFF)
